display_information.name: Eos
display_information.description: Your routines read your conversations and post what you send, as you.
display_information.long_description: Eos runs routines on your Mac. With Slack connected, a routine can read the channels and direct messages you choose, start when a new message arrives or someone mentions you, and draft a message that goes out under your name only after you press Send, or on its own once you let it. Eos has no server: your Mac talks to Slack directly, and your sign-in stays in your Mac's keychain.
